scenario: LUNI.4.1.2 / LIMP.5.1.5 — the baked `units.core` base axes are NON-REDEFINABLE. A local `unit dimension` that redeclares one of the seven base axes (here `mass`) is rejected with DS_VALIDATE_UNIT_IMPORT_COLLISION: the axis is implicitly in scope in every module and redeclaring it would fork the dimensional algebra. Derive new units from the base instead. The `units.core` is the one the repository ships under `stdlib/units/core.ds`, on every fixture's search path ([RCTS.1.2.14]).
